name: outputs.Proofs.FreyaExecution.selected_gradient_integrable
type_text:
∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          0 < q.ρ →
            q.ρ ≤ 1 →
              ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ : ℝ),
                0 ≤ Lminus →
                  outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f q.x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ →
                    ∀ (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal)
                      (O :
                        OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                          (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                        outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.batchScheduleIndependent q f τ O →
                          ∀ (N : ℕ),
                            outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit q ≤ N →
                              MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                (fun z =>
                                  ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f)
                                        (OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.factory q) (fun x => N)
                                            z.1 z.2).1‖ ^
                                    2)
                                ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O)
